text:
We drew a map on an old napkin. It showed the scary forest behind my house. My friend Ben was thrilled to go exploring. We walked for a while and the grass was growing taller.

"This looks impossible to cross," said Ben nervously.

I grinned and gave him a thumbs up. We kept jumping over logs throughout the woods. Suddenly we saw a giant pit. Someone was dumping trash in there! It was gross. I threw a rock in to check the depth. It was deep though.

"I guarantee there is treasure down there," I said.

We found a rope and climbed down fast. We were in a league of our own! We didn't find gold but we found a cool shiny rock. We were hungry so we ate a cookie down to the last crumb. It was the best adventure ever.

My robot Zog had a big shiny metal head. We climbed the rocky mountain to search for the hidden cave. Zog held a heavy iron chain to pull me up.

"Look out for the space bugs!" I shouted loudly.

Suddenly a green alien jumped out and broke a rock. Zog beeped and his eyes turned bright red. He shot a laser but it wasn't strong enough. The alien wanted to eat my protein bar.

"Here, you can receive this yummy snack," I said.

The alien ate it and burped and then ran away. We were safe and walked back home for dinner.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were freezing outside. My mom said we couldn't go in the pool either. So we ran through the grass and touched the cold water.

"Hey look at that big spider!" screamed my friend Ben.

We saw a huge bug crawling on my dad's grill. It looked like it had thirteen legs and was growing fast. I grasped a stick and poked it a little bit.

"Don't hurt it, maybe it needs protein," said my sister.

We ran inside and scattered our sleeping bags on the floor. My mom read us a scary story about a ghost. Then Ben found a loose thread on his pillow. He pulled it and his pillow ripped open everywhere! Feathers went all over the room and we laughed all night.

My brother and I played a racing video game in our apartment. I was winning and my car was super fast. The scenery on the screen was just a blur. I was steering really hard to stay on the road.

Suddenly, my brother chewed on his lip and paused the game.

"Hey! What happened?" I yelled at him.

"I have to sneeze!" he shouted back. He sneezed so hard he blew his nose on his shirt.

While he cleaned up, I unpaused the game and drove away. His car disappeared behind me and I laughed. He scrambled to grab his controller but it was too late. My reign as the champion was just beginning. I played a little longer until I got hungry for pizza.

"You know I let you win," he said.

"Did not!" I said.

It was raining very hard outside on Saturday. My best friend Sam came over and we were bored. We decided to go explore my dark basement. I was afraid but I pretended to be brave. We walked down the stairs and discovered a secret door. I pulled the handle with all my strength.

"Look out!" Sam screamed loudly at me.

A giant rat ran out and started stamping its feet. We were both trembling and scared. My heart was pumping fast. Sam grabbed an old newspaper and swatted at the rat. The rat ran away into a hole. We ran upstairs and ate some toasted bread. We smelled like stewed carrots and dust but we were safe.

"That was too scary," I said to Sam.

We never went back down there again.

My brother and I went to the spooky forest today. It was a weird scene with lots of fog. We walked for a long time and heard a whistle. It sounded like wind, but I believed it was ghosts.

Suddenly, we saw a green light floating near a tree.

"Look at that thing!" I yelled at my brother.

"I think it is a monster," he said back.

We ran fast but I struggled to move my feet. We often play games like this, but this was real. Then I remembered my dog was missing. I heard a low moaning sound behind a big rock. It was either a ghost or my dog. I peeked over the rock. It was just my dog Rex! I am trained at finding lost things. We laughed and took turns steering him home.

My neighbor Tim and I wanted to explore the dark woods. We walked through the tall grass and approached a big cave. It was scary but I felt brave. Tim drew a map on a piece of paper.

"Do you think a bear is sleeping inside?" asked Tim.

"Maybe, but we have super powers today," I said.

We went inside and something was bumping around in the dark. My heart rose up to my throat. Suddenly a tiny puppy came jumping out at us! It chewed on my shoe and wagged its tail. We laughed because we thought it was a monster. The puppy led us back to the sunlight and the soft earth. We ran home jumping over logs at a great height. My dad was coaching soccer but we told him our cool story.

I really wanted to win the big race at school. My friend Max is super fast, but I had a plan. We lined up at the start and the whistle blew. I started running as fast as a rocket.

"You can't catch me!" Max yelled from way ahead.

I was yearning to win so bad. I pushed my legs harder and harder. Suddenly, my shoe felt loose like a bouncy bungee cord. I almost fell, but I kept my balance to maintain my speed. Then the finish line appeared right in front of me. I was clinging to hope. Max looked back and slowed down a little bit. I zoomed past him and crossed the line first!

"Let's race again!" I shouted happily. I was the champion.

Me and my best friend Leo went exploring in the jungle. It was hot and we searched for a secret trail. We pushed through big green leaves and walked for a long time. Suddenly we saw a big dark cave.

"Do you think a bear lives there?" Leo asked.

I was scared but I wanted to be brave. We went inside the cave and sat on a rock. It was very quiet until we heard a ringing sound.

"What is that noise?" I screamed.

It was just my phone ringing! My mom was calling me. We ran home fast though because it was getting dark. We didn't want to get a grounding so we promised to remain close next time. Exploring is fun but scary too.

Tomorrow is my big birthday party. I helped my dad with loading the car. We put everything in the back for the picnic. The weather is going to be super sunny and hot.

"Can we go boating on the lake?" I asked my dad.

"Maybe if we have time after lunch," he said.

I tried to squeeze my giant floatie into the trunk. It was a tight squeeze! I had to search through my bag for my comb. My hair was messy from the wind. I felt the weight of the cooler. It was really heavy with all the sodas. My little sister tried keeping the beat to a song. She has no rhythm at all. I hope I learn to drive the boat. I want to reign over the lake like a queen! It will be the best day ever.

Me and my friend Sam played a racing video game. We raced cars on a dirt trail throughout the jungle. My car was red and Sam’s car was blue. I moved my controller fast, but Sam was winning.

Suddenly, a little white lamb ran onto the track!

"Watch out for the lamb!" yelled Sam.

I swerved my car and hit a metal chain fence. My car spun around and got stuck in the mud. Sam drove past me and he looked very happy. Even though I crashed, seeing the lamb was funny.

After the race, we ate some roasted peanuts for a snack. To be honest, I meant to win that race today. Maybe next time I will win without crashing. It was fun roaming around the track anyway.

Last Wednesday, my dog Max ran into the woods behind our house. I chased him because he kept barking at something big. We pushed through some bushes and found a secret garden. It had a big stone fountain in the middle with green water.

"Come back here right now, Max!" I screamed loudly.

Max did not listen and he jumped right into the water. Then I discovered a box near the fountain's edge. I opened it with my safety scissors from my pocket. Inside the box were five shiny gold coins that I counted carefully. It seemed impossible but the treasure was real.

"Look what we found, boy," I told him happily.

Max just splashed me and shook his wet fur everywhere. He is good company even when he is messy. We took the coins home and put them in my piggy bank.

It was my sister’s big birthday party. We scattered confetti everywhere and decorated the room. I wanted to maintain the surprise for her. Mom baked a huge chocolate cake in the oven. Unfortunately, the top of the cake got scorched. It looked black and crispy.

"Oh no, it’s impossible to eat!" I yelled.

Mom scraped off the burnt part and iced it again. It looked okay but I feared it tasted bad. When my sister reached for a slice, she smiled. She blew out the candles and took a big bite.

"This is the best cake ever!" she said.

I was so happy she liked it. We meant to play outside, but it rained. So we slept in the living room instead.

One day I went exploring in the woods behind my house. I was wearing my favorite red boots and a blue hat. I pretended I was deep in a thick green jungle. Suddenly I saw a squirrel swinging from a high branch. He jumped and landed right on the soft earth near me.

"Hello Mr. Squirrel!" I shouted at him loudly.

The squirrel looked at me and then he started running away. I chased him throughout the trees until he stopped by a rock. He grasped a tiny nut in his paws and grinned.

"You are very fast," I said to the squirrel.

Later I went inside and read a book about animals. Then I wrote a story about my jungle adventure. I can't wait to go back outside tomorrow.

My best friend Sam had a sleepover for his birthday. We played outside with his neighbor named Leo. We pretended we were strong superheroes. I used my imagination to be the champion of the world. "Use your super strength!" yelled Sam. We started running fast and pumping our arms. Then Leo screeched like a bird and jumped off the swing. He didn't have a bungee cord so he fell. He crushed some flowers but he was okay. His mom came out singing a happy song with cake. We scattered everywhere to get plates. "Do you want chocolate or vanilla?" she asked. I didn't care because I like either one. Following the cake we tried to measure who was tallest. It was the best night ever.

We went to the woods to build a secret castle. My dog Buster came too and he was very excited. We searched for big sticks and some soft green moss. I saw a leaf floating in a puddle nearby. It had a big red vein down the middle.

"Look at this weird bug," said my friend Sam. It looked like a foreign bug from a faraway place.

Buster ran over and accidentally crushed the bug with his paw. We felt bad so we decided to write a note. We spread some dirt over the bug to bury it.

"I think the bug is grateful now," I said.

Sam grinned and we went back to building our fort. My dad was coaching my brother at soccer so we had lots of time. We played until the sun went down.

We were walking through the thick green jungle. My friend Sam was bringing his backpack with snacks. We were looking for the lost red jewel. The scenery was full of big trees and vines. Suddenly a monkey screeched loudly at us from above.

"Look out for that snake!" yelled Sam.

I threw a stick and the snake slithered away. We had to squeeze through a small dark cave. I was scared but I remembered my training.

"We are almost there," I said to Sam.

We saw a box that might contain the treasure. I touched the lid and it opened slowly. Seeing the shiny jewel was so cool! We felt like a brave colonel in a movie. My mom might give me a grounding for being late. But finding the treasure was the best adventure ever.

One day I was walking on a long trail in the woods. I was feeling very happy because the sun was hot. Suddenly I saw a big brown dog running fast. He was tearing through the bushes and barking loud!

"Hey doggy, where are you going?" I asked him.

The dog stopped and wagged his tail at me. Then a girl came running up the path.

"Sorry! I am coaching him to be good," she said.

We had a nice meeting right there in the grass. She told me they were going boating on the lake later. I was certain that the dog would like swimming. I watched them leave and I learn that dogs are very fast. It was a good day to be outside.

My cat Fluffy is certain she is a queen. She sits on the balcony and watches the birds fly through the air. One day I was loading my backpack for a picnic. I carefully packed a toasted cheese sandwich and a juice box.

"Meow!" Fluffy said loudly because she wanted to go.

"You have to stay here simply because you are a cat," I told her.

She started to complain and spread her paws on the glass door. I felt bad so I gave her a piece of string like a thread to play with. Then I went to the park by the big water fountain. An old man was reading a newspaper on a bench nearby. I ate my sandwich and enjoyed the company of the squirrels. They looked like they wanted some stewed carrots, but I didn't have any.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were bearing big sticks for protection because it was scary. We walked straight until we saw a huge, dark cave.

"I think there is a bear in there," Sam said.

"I have trained for this moment," I told him bravely.

Suddenly we heard a loud sounding roar from the cave. My heart was beating like a drum rhythm. A huge monster jumped out and broke a branch! We ran away with all our strength. My pants got caught on a bush tearing a hole. I believed we were in big trouble. We didn't remain there. We ran left and finally got home safe. I need scissors to fix my pants now.

My neighbor Timmy and I were roaming around the playground at recess. We pretended the monkey bars were a big green jungle.

"I bet there is treasure under the slide!" Timmy shouted.

I ran over to the slide and started digging in the dirt. I found a shiny rock and a blue bird feather. It was the best single thing I found all day. Then the bell rang and everyone started moaning. We had to go inside for science class.

"I am the champion of digging," I told Timmy.

Mrs. Green looked tired and she drank a lot of coffee for the caffeine. Although she was tired, she taught us about camping and bugs. It was actually fun. I felt like a colonel leading an army of ants. School is okay but recess is way better.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the dark forest. It was a dangerous place with lots of stinging bugs. We were looking for the lost treasure of the monkey king. We walked for a long time and saw strange foreign scenery.

"Watch out for that hole!" yelled Sam loudly.

I almost fell in but I grabbed a vine like a bungee cord. My heart was bumping hard in my chest. We kept walking and heard loud stamping noises. It was a giant bear! We ran very fast and escaped to a cave.

"That was scary but wonderful," I said shaking.

We touched the ground and had a happy feeling. We were safe. We heard people cheering for us outside. We didn't find the gold but it was a cool adventure.

It was finally my birthday and I was jumping everywhere. My best friend Sam was approaching my front door. I grinned because he had a huge blue box. We ran to the park near the big stone fountain. Sam threw the ball and it went really high up. I ran fast but I tripped on a rock. I started moaning because my knee hurt a little bit.

"Are you okay?" Sam asked, sounding very worried.

"I am fine, let's keep playing!" I said.

My mom cleared the picnic table for cake. It was chocolate with a shiny jewel on top. I felt so grateful for my party. The day felt complete when I got a new bike. I love birthdays so much.

I was walking past a big grey building yesterday. A green alien jumped out and he was trembling. He looked like a giant frog with blue skin. A big purple vein popped out on his head. He chewed on a metal bar like it was gum.

"Do you have any caffeine?" the alien asked me.

"No, my mom says that makes me crazy," I said.

He blew green smoke out of his nose and crossed his arms. He did not understand why I had no soda. Then a robot flew down and grabbed him. The robot had lasers for eyes and looked scary. They flew away into the sky very fast. I ran home to tell my dog.

One day I was walking outside my apartment building. I saw something shiny in the grass like a jewel. It was my neighbor’s cat, Mittens! She was stuck way up high on a tree branch. Mittens was groaning and looked very scared of the height.

"Oh no, Mittens is in trouble!" I shouted loudly.

I remembered my dad had a ladder in the garage. I ran and got it simply by myself. I climbed up like I was climbing a mountain. Mittens was happy and started jumping into my arms. I felt very brave when I discovered I could save her.

"Thank you for saving her!" my neighbor said.

She was so grateful she gave me five dollars. I used my imagination to think about what candy to buy. Then I saw a newspaper on the ground and we went home.

I was playing my favorite video game against my brother. It was a race game with super fast cars. The track went up into space and there was no gravity. If you drove off the road, it was dangerous! My car was a giant blue elephant with wheels.

"You are going down!" my brother yelled at me.

"No way, I drank too much soda so I have caffeine energy!" I said back.

I was seeing the finish line but then I hit a weird bump. My elephant car spun around and crashed into a water fountain. It was a big failure. My brother reached the end first. He laughed, but I just felt the breeze from the fan. I threw my controller on the ground. Next time I will win for sure.

I was training for the big race at school. My friend Sam said it was impossible to beat him. We neared the finish line on the playground. I jumped over a big rock and climbed a hill. Sam was clinging to the lead but he looked tired.

"I am going to win!" I screamed really loud.

"No way!" Sam shouted back at me.

My legs were trembling but I ran faster. I remembered my dad speaking about never giving up. I pushed hard and crushed Sam at the end. I fell on the earth and got a grass stain. It felt like I was bungee jumping because my heart was fast. Next week we are camping, but today I am the winner.

It was raining outside so we stayed inside. My brother and I were roaming around the living room. We were bored until Mom called us for dinner. But we were not hungry so we played video games. The game was loading forever and it made me mad. Then the screen turned bright like heaven.

"I am going to win this time!" I yelled.

"You already lost last time," my brother said.

We picked our players and went straight to the race. I was simply faster than him. He looked sad but kept playing. I saw the finish line and knew it was over. I won the race and started singing a victory song. My brother was hanging his head down. We played again to complete the level.

I was afraid to go to school today. Mrs. Miller said we had a big test. My stomach was groaning all morning. Mom made me toasted bread with jam, but I couldn't eat. I walked to the bus and greeted my friend Sam.

"Did you complete the homework?" asked Sam.

"No, I forgot!" I said, screaming a little bit.

We got to class and sat down. Then Mrs. Miller smiled at us. She said, "Surprise! No test today. We are doing art instead."

I was thrilled! We discovered new paints and spread blue color everywhere. It was the greatest day ever. We are training to be artists now.

I woke up early because I was yearning for adventure. My friend Max and I ran to the spooky island. The ground was hot and looked scorched by fire. 

"I guarantee a dragon lives here," Max grumbled loudly.

Suddenly, a giant shadow spread over us and we froze. A red dragon landed and it struck the ground hard. It was breathing smoke and bearing huge teeth at us. We were not trained to fight dragons!

"Run for the boat!" I screeched at Max.

We kept running until we jumped into the water. We were safe but we are never going back there.

I was playing my favorite video game about a sailor. He was roaming around a big green mountain. My neighbor Tim came over to play against me. He was wearing his lucky red hat for good luck. We climbed up the rocks in the game really fast. I was afraid I would lose because Tim is good. But then my fingers moved super fast on the controller. I felt stronger than him and I jumped over a trap.

"You are going to lose!" Tim yelled at me loudly.

"No way, I am winning this time!" I shouted back.

I realized I could win if I found the secret treasure. The surrounding monsters tried to stop me but I beat them. My dad was coaching me from the door and smiling. I won the game and Tim was sad but okay. I hope he doesn't get pneumonia from walking home in the rain.

One day I met a alien named Zorg in my backyard. He was green and chewed on a shiny metal rock. I carefully walked up to him and he waved his three hands.

"Do you want some roasted space bugs?" Zorg asked me.

"No thanks, that sounds gross," I said.

Then a big robot came down from the sky with a loud groaning noise. It was Colonel Click-Clack and he wanted to catch Zorg. Zorg threw his metal rock at the robot's head. The robot fell down and made a trail of smoke. I did not understand why they were fighting but it was cool. We used a box to contain the robot. Then Zorg gave me a map to guide him home.

It was a cold night in February and I was scared. A green robot with huge laser eyes was approaching my house. I was clinging to my magic sword behind the sofa. The robot smashed the door open with lots of anger.

"Give me the blue jewel!" the robot yelled loudly.

I jumped up and flew into the air with my cape. "You can never have it!" I shouted back at him.

I zapped him with my laser eyes and he fell down. He started screaming and moaning on the floor. It was loud enough to wake up my mom. I grabbed the jewel and hid it under my bed forever. The robot ran away and never came back again.

My friends and I went into the dark, scary cave. We walked through the cold tunnel for a long time. Suddenly, a big drop of water hit my thumb. I looked up at the high ceiling. It was too dark to see a single thing. 

"Do you know where we are going?" asked Sam.

"We need to find the dragon's gold," I said bravely.

We heard a loud roar echo in the cave. A monster brewed a potion nearby and it smelled like stewed socks. That was enough for us to run away fast! We did not want the monster to reign over us. We escaped by just a finger and ran home.

Me and my friend Sam searched for the hidden treasure. We ran through the woods and felt a cold breeze. Sam wore his blue sweater because it was chilly. We kept running until we saw a big stone castle.

"I think the map leads inside there," Sam said.

We went in and a giant bird landed near us. It made a loud whistle sound that was scary. I reached in my pocket and found some scissors. I also found a receipt for milk, but that was useless.

"Let's scare it away!" I yelled loudly.

We waved our arms and the bird flew away fast. We found a chest and inside was just gold paper. I woke up and realized I was only dreaming.

My brother and I went on a big camping trip. We started loading the car early in the morning. Dad drove us to a beautiful forest for our adventure. We saw a little lamb roaming near the trees.

"Look at that jumping lamb!" I yelled to my brother.

We walked deep into the woods and crossed a river. Suddenly, I dropped my bag and heard a loud groaning sound. It was a bear! We ran fast and I felt like a champion runner.

"We are safe now," my brother said.

We were thrilled to be back at the tent. Mom made a cool design with stones by the fire. I was so grateful for the hot dogs. Camping is scary but it is also very fun.

My robot nephew Zog was boating in the sky. He had a big red jewel on his chest. It was the greatest jewel in the whole galaxy.

"Look out for the ceiling!" I yelled at him.

Zog was running fast but he hit the clouds. The clouds were actually stinging space bees. They were mad and started chasing us to my balcony.

"This is impossible!" Zog said with a loud beep.

We used science to make a force field quickly. The bees were groaning because they couldn't get in. Zog roasted a marshmallow on his hot engine. I hope he doesn't get robot pneumonia from the cold space wind. His reign as the king of flying robots is safe.

I was sitting at my desk groaning because of math. There was a big mountain of homework to do. I had to write the answers on the computer. Suddenly I heard a loud knock on the door. It was my friend Tommy and he looked afraid.

"Come quick!" he yelled. "The water fountain exploded!"

I jumped up and grasped my pencil tight. We ran into the hall and saw water everywhere. A huge stain was spreading on the carpet. I saw the janitor trying to seize the mop. He fought the water but he slipped and sank down.

"I will help!" I shouted like a champion.

I ran over and turned the handle eight times. The water stopped and everyone clapped for me. I felt happy but then I remembered my math. I walked back to class very slowly.

We were playing soccer at recess and I was the captain. The other team was really good but we were following the ball everywhere. Suddenly, my friend Ben kicked it super hard. The ball crashed right into the goal and we all cheered.

"We are totally going to win this!" I yelled.

But then the other team got the ball back. They ran fast and I heard my heart thumping. Their best player kicked it and it hit the pole.

"Oh man, so close!" he shouted while groaning.

The bell rang and the teacher appeared by the water fountain. We were tired and sweaty like roasted chickens. But we won the game and I felt like a champion. It was the best recess ever.

My brother Tom thinks he is the best at everything. We were playing baseball in the backyard on Saturday. I was waiting for my turn to hit the ball. Tom threw the ball really fast at my head! I felt anger inside me but I didn't say anything. I grabbed the bat and started swinging hard.

"That's enough!" my mom yelled from the back porch.

I dropped the bat and started groaning because it wasn't fair. Tom laughed at me like he always does. I tried to explain that he threw it too fast. He said he was using psychology to mess up my game. Next time I will strike him out for sure.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old forest. We started roaming around and looking for treasure. Sam bought a map from our neighbor. It showed a big red X near the twisted tree. We walked for a long time. My backpack had too much weight.

"I see something!" Sam screamed.

It was a big hole. We saw a strange box inside. I threw a rock at it. Nothing happened. Suddenly a colonel came out of the bushes! He looked like a science teacher but scary. He was loading a net gun.

"You aren't leaving with that!" he yelled.

We ran fast and scratched our legs on bushes. We didn't get the gold either. But we spread the news to everyone at school. Next time we will bring flashlights.

I climbed up the tallest tree and sat on a branch. My robot dog Sparky flew up next to me. We saw a plain silver spaceship approaching fast. It landed near the park fountain with a loud thumping noise. A green alien walked out and greeted us with a wave.

"Is that a treasure chest?" asked Sparky loudly.

The alien nodded and opened the box. Smoke spread throughout the air gradually. Inside was a mountain of roasted marshmallows! It seemed impossible, but there was enough for everyone.

"Yum, let's eat!" I shouted happily.

We ate marshmallows all day until our tummies hurt.

Me and my dog Buster went deep into the woods. We were looking for a secret fort. Buster started sniffing a big bush. Suddenly he ran off and I got scared.

"Buster come back!" I yelled really loud.

I heard a whistle sound but it was just the wind. I walked for an hour and felt like I was in trouble. The trees surrounding me looked very tall and scary. Then I saw something floating in the river. It was Buster's red ball!

I struck a stick against a tree to make noise. Buster barked and ran out from behind a rock. He was trembling because he was wet and cold.

"You are a bad dog," I said but I hugged him.

We went home and ate toasted marshmallows by the fire. Next time I will keep him on his leash.

My brother Tim thinks he is stronger than me. We played a new video game about climbing big mountains. The game had a cool design with bright colors. I picked a character from a foreign land with blue hair. Tim picked a big robot guy with huge arms.

"You are playing it all wrong," Tim said loudly.

I ignored him and pushed the buttons really fast. My character sprinted up the mountain and jumped over rocks. I felt my brain working hard to win. Neither of us blinked for a long time. Suddenly I saw a secret path through the trees. I was certain I could win now.

"Hey, how did you do that?" Tim yelled.

I crossed the finish line first and did a happy dance. I beat him and it felt great!

Yesterday I was playing my favorite video game. It was a cold day in February, so I stayed inside. My character was a brave knight roaming through a big castle. I gripped my controller tight because I was nervous. My big brother was sitting next to me and coaching me.

"Watch out for the dragon!" he yelled loudly.

I jumped over the fire and bounced off a wall. Then I crashed into the big boss monster. My score was growing higher and higher. It was a beautiful win!

"You finally beat the level!" my brother said.

I was so happy that I did a victory dance. We played games all afternoon until dinner time.

My robot Sparky and I went to search for space rocks. We were on the red planet Mars. Suddenly, I heard a loud noise behind a big hill. A green alien jumped out and screamed at us!

"Run away fast, Sparky!" I yelled.

We scrambled over the rocks, but my foot got trapped. The alien was getting closer gradually. I tried to pull my foot out, but I didn't have enough strength. Sparky used his metal arms to squeeze the rock. He was groaning because it was so heavy.

"Maintain your power!" I shouted to him.

Sparky broke the rock and we were free. We ran back to the ship for training. Next time we will bring bigger lasers.

My dog Buster loves playing outside in the big woods. Yesterday, he saw a squirrel and ran very fast. I chased him past fourteen big trees. Suddenly, Buster crashed right into a muddy bush. He was swinging his tail but he looked stuck.

"Buster, stop moving!" I shouted loudly at him.

He struggled to get out, but the thorns held him tight. I saw something surrounding his leg. It was an old vine that grew there. I carefully chewed on my lip while I thought. Then I pulled the vine away. Buster jumped out and started dumping mud everywhere.

"You are a messy boy," I said with a laugh.

He was hungry so he led me back home. It was important to give him a big dinner. We were both tired.

My birthday party was a jungle theme. Everyone came to my house for a sleepover. My mom made a big cake with green frosting. It looked like green grass on a computer game. We played a game where we were breathing really quiet. We had to sneak past my dad who was sleeping. He had a newspaper on his face and snored loud.

"Watch out for the danger!" whispered my friend Sam.

I tickled my dad’s nose with a soft feather. He woke up fast and started bumping into the wall. It was so funny and we all started cheering. The noise grew very loud in the living room. Then we ate pizza and watched a movie. It was the best birthday ever.

It was my sister’s birthday and we planned a surprise. Mom brewed some hot chocolate and we started loading the car. We drove to the petting zoo because Sarah loves animals.

"Listen! Do you hear that?" Sarah asked us excitedly.

We saw a tiny lamb floating in a little pond. It was actually just swimming but it looked funny. Then Sarah discovered a shiny rock near the water. It looked like a real jewel but it was just glass.

I tried to pick up the lamb but it was a failure. I got mud on my shirt and made a big stain.

"That is not a pleasant smell," Mom said laughing.

We opened presents on the grass and it was a pleasure. Sarah loved her day even though I was muddy.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old cave. It looked different than before because it was dark and scary. We climbed over big rocks and pushed through some sticky webs. Sam held a small knife to cut the vines.

"Do you see anything?" Sam asked me quietly.

"Neither of us can see in the dark," I said back.

Suddenly, we saw a shiny blue light ahead. We walked slowly and gradually got closer to the glow. It was a huge, bright jewel on a stone. I knew it was magic. I picked it up and felt the heavy weight in my hand. Then a loud roar greeted us from the shadows! We ran very fast all the way home. We were safe but we left the jewel behind.
